summary: Tested new features: Voucher CRUD, Agent/Dealer system, Business Card, OG Meta Tags, and Storefront cart removal. All 24 backend API tests passed. Fixed agent auth/me endpoint bug. Frontend UI tests confirmed all tabs working.

fixed.issue: Agent tokens caused 500 error because agent IDs (agt-xxx) were being passed to ObjectId()
fixed.fix: Added check for agent ID prefix in get_current_user() to raise HTTPException instead of bson.errors.InvalidId

storefront_cart_removal.notes: No Add to Cart button or cart icon found on storefront page

shop_owner_dashboard.voucher_tab: PASS - Shows voucher list with create/edit/delete functionality
shop_owner_dashboard.agents_tab: PASS - Shows agent list with stats (3 agents, total sales, admin sales)
shop_owner_dashboard.business_card_tab: PASS - Shows card form with name, title, phone, email, product selection

storefront_page.cart_removed: PASS - No Add to Cart button or cart icon visible

business_card_page.public_card: PASS - Shows card with name, title, shop, contact actions (call, zalo, email, save)

updated_files: /app/backend/server.py - Fixed get_current_user() to handle agent tokens
seed_data_creation: Created test vouchers and agents during testing (prefixed with TEST/UPD/DEL)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features (Voucher, Agent, Business Card, OG Meta Tags) are working. Agent login flow works at API level. The shop slug for demo1 shop owner is 'demo1'. Agents feature must be enabled via Super Admin before creating agents.

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: The get_current_user() function tried to convert agent IDs (format: agt-xxx) to MongoDB ObjectId, which failed with bson.errors.InvalidId
rca_of_the_issue.fix_applied: Added check for agent ID prefix (agt-) in get_current_user() to raise HTTPException with 401 status, allowing the /auth/me endpoint to handle agent tokens separately
rca_of_the_issue.verification: Agent login and dashboard now work correctly
